title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
keyIdea: Start with n components. Union-Find each edge: if the two ends have different roots, merge them and subtract 1. Or count DFS starts over the unvisited nodes.

approaches.name: DFS from each unvisited node
approaches.idea: Build adjacency lists; each unvisited node starts a new component; DFS marks everything connected to it.
approaches.why: Every node and edge is visited once.

approaches.name: Union-Find, counting merges
approaches.idea: components = n; for each edge, roots differ → parent[pu] = pv, components--.
approaches.why: Each find is nearly constant time with path compression; no adjacency lists needed.

quiz.q: Why does the count start at n?
options: Every node is its own component before any edge is added
When an edge joins two different roots (two separate groups)

quiz.q: What does an edge between two nodes already in one group do?

options: Both about O(n + E); Union-Find needs no adjacency lists and handles edges arriving one by one
